content.short: Rise In provides free Web3-focused educational programs to empower Web3 developers globally.
content.description: Rise In tackles the shortage of qualified blockchain developers by delivering free, in-depth education that covers the essentials needed to succeed in Web3. Through structured courses, mentorship, and practical projects, developers can transition from Web2 to Web3 and gain hands-on experience. Learners pick up Solidity, Rust, and TypeScript, assemble a compelling project portfolio, and join a worldwide community. This empowers them to build innovative solutions and accelerate their careers amid the fast-changing blockchain landscape.
content.meta: Rise In addresses the need for skilled blockchain developers with free, comprehensive education. Discover Rise In and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
